title: A Knowledge Compilation Map
inspection: Primary paper; query/transformation map and conditioning discussion
relevant_fact: Succinctness and supported operations are an established evaluation framework.
consequence: No first-paradigm claim; use representation-specific operational evidence.

title: Graph-Based Algorithms for Boolean Function Manipulation
relevant_fact: Reduced ordered decision diagrams are established exact Boolean representations.
consequence: Python fixed-order implementation is only a reference; optimized CUDD is not claimed.

title: An Approach to Disjoint-Support Decomposition of Logic Functions
inspection: Three-page author-hosted paper, text and page inspected
relevant_fact: Boolean disjoint-support structure has established algorithms.
overlap: XOR/product family primitives are not new.
consequence: Cite background; do not infer that the new recognizer supersedes DSD.

authors: Tempia Calvino, Mishchenko, De Micheli and Brayton
title: Practical Boolean Decomposition for Delay-driven LUT Mapping
inspection: Primary HTML; decomposition, cofactor multiplicity and stated scale
relevant_fact: Truth-table-based ACD targets useful local-function decompositions for LUT mapping.
consequence: Hardware objectives and selector encodings differ from scalar counting.

authors: Hien, Walter, Tempia Calvino, Mishchenko and Wille
title: Ashenhurst-Curtis Decomposition Using Don't Cares
inspection: Primary author-hosted paper; abstract and care-set formulation inspected
overlap: Important if this work later supports partial specifications.
consequence: No importing dont-care freedom into exact counts of a fully specified function.

title: Tensor Decomposition Meets Knowledge Compilation: A Study Comparing Tensor Trains with OBDDs
inspection: Primary paper; definitions, tractable-operation table, conditioning/counting and fixed-order comparison
relevant_fact: Tensor trains already have a Boolean knowledge-compilation treatment.
consequence: GF(2) factors differ from ordinary-arithmetic TT; fixed-cut rank gap is not TT refutation.

title: Certified Knowledge Compilation with Application to Formally Verified Model Counting
inspection: Primary JAIR paper / arXiv version; abstract, certification pipeline and scope; formal proof not independently rechecked
relevant_fact: Checkable compiled representations and formal checking/counting predate this report.
consequence: Call this tested separate Python checking, not first-certified or formal verification.

title: Factorization of Binary Matrices: Rank Relations, Uniqueness and Model Selection of Boolean Decomposition
inspection: Primary abstract and rank-notion framing; no full independent theorem audit
relevant_fact: Binary matrices support different arithmetic-dependent rank notions.
overlap: Requires care distinguishing GF(2), real and Boolean-semiring ranks.
consequence: The manuscript supplies its own proof for the specific inner-product example.

title: Faster Walsh-Hadamard and Discrete Fourier Transforms From Matrix Non-Rigidity
overlap: The sign-sum identity uses standard characters and a conventional butterfly.
consequence: No novel transform algorithm claimed; do not use a dense transform when workspace is excessive.

authors: Kimmig, Van den Broeck and De Raedt
title: Algebraic Model Counting
relevant_fact: Semiring-valued counting provides broader established context.
overlap: Weighted-query extension is not an unexplored paradigm.
consequence: Weighted results not claimed as implemented in this report.

title: Parallel Weighted Model Counting with Tensor Networks
inspection: Primary paper; abstract and algorithmic setup
relevant_fact: Tensor-network model counting predates the TT comparison.
overlap: Factor-based counting is not a new general approach.
consequence: Different graph-contraction and parallel endpoint; no performance comparison claimed.

title: EPFL Combinational Benchmark Suite
inspection: Complete 99-line raw source and official MIT license; bytes hash matched
overlap: One real source for bounded exact queries.
consequence: One related design is not a prevalence corpus.

title: Adaptive Sparse Mobius Transforms for Learning Polynomials
inspection: Abstract and stated oracle/arithmetic scope; not a full proof audit
relevant_fact: Sparse real-valued Boolean polynomial recovery uses adaptive oracle queries.
overlap: Relevant to a different sparse-discovery input model.
consequence: Deferred; not automatically a GF(2) ANF recognizer or a contradiction of the value-oracle bound.

title: The framework to unify all complexity dichotomy theorems for Boolean tensor networks
inspection: Abstract and version history only; triage, not proof audit
relevant_fact: Studies complex-valued fixed-signature tensor-network counting classes.
overlap: A broad nearby complexity program with a different input language.
consequence: Not incorporated; do not describe the framework as having solved all cases.
